# Laravel Wafeq

> A typed Laravel client for the Wafeq accounting API, including ZATCA e-invoicing. Every Wafeq endpoint is exposed as a resource behind the `LaravelWafeq` facade and returns `spatie/laravel-data` DTOs. Root namespace: `HWafeq\LaravelWafeq`. Requires PHP ^8.3 and Laravel ^11.0 || ^12.0 || ^13.0. Package: `mohamedhabibwork/laravel-wafeq`.

Package summary: 44 Wafeq resources, 120 FormRequests, 19 typed enums, 11 shared DTOs, and a ZATCA client with 5 resource groups. All names below come from the source tree in this repository.

## Key facts

- Entry point: `LaravelWafeq::<accessor>()` returns a resource, for example `LaravelWafeq::contacts()`. `LaravelWafeq::zatca()` returns the ZATCA client.
- Resource methods: `list()`, `retrieve($id)`, `create($payload)`, `update($id, $payload)`, `partialUpdate($id, $payload)`, `destroy($id)`, plus resource-specific extras such as `markAsDraft`, `markAsPosted`, `invoice`, `bill`, `taxAuthorityReport`, `bulkSend`, `preview*`, and `endEarly*`.
- Responses are hydrated into typed DTOs. `list()` returns `PaginatedData` with `results`. Wire format is snake_case; DTO properties are camelCase.
- Nested resources take the parent id first, for example `LaravelWafeq::bankLedgerTransactions()->list('ba_123')` and `LaravelWafeq::payslipsPayItems()->list('pay_123')`.
- Eloquent models can be passed to `*Model()` methods such as `createFromModel`, `retrieveModel`, `updateModel`, `partialUpdateModel`, and `destroyModel`. Alternatively, use the `HasWafeqResource` trait and call `$model->wafeq()`.
- Every mutating accounting call sends a UUID idempotency header (`X-Wafeq-Idempotency-Key` by default). Retries are safe.
- Unknown ZATCA device-status and wallet-balance values hydrate to `null` through `LenientEnumCast` instead of throwing.
- `WAFEQ_CURRENCY` sets the default currency. `#[WithCurrency]` fills DTO properties from it when the response omits a value.
- ZATCA defaults to the `simulation` environment. Switch with `WAFEQ_ZATCA_ENVIRONMENT=production` or `->production()`. ZATCA requests send no idempotency key.
- Non-2xx responses are thrown as typed exceptions under `HWafeq\LaravelWafeq\Exceptions`.
- Install with `composer require mohamedhabibwork/laravel-wafeq`. The service provider and facade are auto-discovered. Set `WAFEQ_API_KEY` in `.env`.

## Quick start

```php
use HWafeq\LaravelWafeq\Facades\LaravelWafeq;
use HWafeq\LaravelWafeq\Enums\Currency;

$page = LaravelWafeq::contacts()->list(['limit' => 50]);

$contact = LaravelWafeq::contacts()->create([
    'name'     => 'Acme Inc.',
    'type'     => 'business',
    'currency' => Currency::SAR->value,
]);

LaravelWafeq::contacts()->destroy('ct_123');
```

## ZATCA e-invoicing

- Entry point: `LaravelWafeq::zatca()` returns [`ZatcaClient`](src/ZatcaClient.php), which is immutable.
- Scoping methods: `simulation()`, `production()`, `withEnvironment($env)`, `forBranch($tin)`, `forConnectedAccount($id)`. Each returns a re-scoped copy that sends `X-ZATCA-Environment`, `X-ZATCA-Branch`, and `X-ZATCA-Connected-Account-Id` headers.
- Read-only accessors: `environment()`, `branch()`, `connectedAccount()`, `headers()`.
- Document families: `invoices()`, `creditNotes()`, `debitNotes()`, `prepaymentInvoices()`, `simplifiedInvoices()`, `simplifiedCreditNotes()`, `simplifiedDebitNotes()`, `prepaymentSimplifiedInvoices()`, and `documents(ZatcaDocumentType::…)`.
- Document operations: `report`, `validate`, `bulkReport`, `bulkValidate`, `issue`, `bulkIssue` (simplified only), `list`, `retrieve`, `updateMetadata`, `download`, `retry`, `send`.
- Other accessors: `devices()` (`list`, `retrieve`, `renew`, `revoke`, and `register` for onboarding), `connectedAccounts()` (CRUD), and `usage()` (remaining document credits).
- Resources: [ZatcaDocumentsResource](src/Resources/Zatca/ZatcaDocumentsResource.php), [ZatcaSimplifiedDocumentsResource](src/Resources/Zatca/ZatcaSimplifiedDocumentsResource.php), [ZatcaDevicesResource](src/Resources/Zatca/ZatcaDevicesResource.php), [ZatcaConnectedAccountsResource](src/Resources/Zatca/ZatcaConnectedAccountsResource.php), [ZatcaUsageResource](src/Resources/Zatca/ZatcaUsageResource.php).
- Response DTOs: [src/Data/Zatca](src/Data/Zatca/): `ZatcaDocumentData` (`id()`, `statusEnum()`, `isReported()`, `needsRetry()`), `ZatcaDocumentSummaryData`, `ZatcaDocumentReferenceData`, `ZatcaValidationResultData`, `ZatcaDeviceData`, `ZatcaConnectedAccountData`, `ZatcaUsageData` (`isBlocked()`). They have no `extra` catch-all.
- Payload DTOs (typed builder): [src/Data/Zatca/Payload](src/Data/Zatca/Payload/). All extend `ZatcaPayloadData`, whose `toPayload()` returns snake_case wire data with nulls dropped. Every resource method accepts them wherever it accepts an array.
  - Document: `ZatcaDocumentPayloadData` (customer defaults to an anonymous B2C buyer, sent as `{}`), `ZatcaSupplierData`, `ZatcaCustomerData`, `ZatcaAddressData`, `ZatcaPartyIdentificationData` (`commercialRegistration()`, `supplier()`, `customer()`), `ZatcaLineItemData` (`make()`, 15% VAT by default), `ZatcaLineItemIdentifiersData`, `ZatcaStandardItemIdentifierData`, `ZatcaTaxData` (`standard()`, `zeroRated()`, `exempt()`, `outOfScope()`), `ZatcaChargeData`, `ZatcaDiscountData`, `ZatcaPrepaymentData`, `ZatcaPaymentMeansData`.
  - Request bodies: `ZatcaReportRequestData` (document plus options in the flat wire shape; `for($document, $options)`), `ZatcaDeliveryOptionsData` (`channels`, `language`, `metadata`, `reference`, `template`), `ZatcaChannelData` (`email()`), `ZatcaDeviceRegistrationData`, `ZatcaConnectedAccountPayloadData`, `ZatcaMetadataUpdateData`.
  - Explicit `$options` passed to `report` / `validate` / `issue` override the keys carried by a `ZatcaReportRequestData`.
- Form requests: [src/Requests/Zatca](src/Requests/Zatca/), 15 concrete classes plus the abstract `ZatcaDocumentFormRequest`.
  - One per document family, shared by `report`, `validate` and `issue`: `ReportZatcaInvoiceRequest`, `ReportZatcaCreditNoteRequest`, `ReportZatcaDebitNoteRequest`, `ReportZatcaPrepaymentInvoiceRequest`, `ReportZatcaSimplifiedInvoiceRequest`, `ReportZatcaSimplifiedCreditNoteRequest`, `ReportZatcaSimplifiedDebitNoteRequest`, `ReportZatcaPrepaymentSimplifiedInvoiceRequest`. `toDto()` returns `ZatcaReportRequestData`.
  - Others: `SendZatcaDocumentRequest`, `UpdateZatcaDocumentMetadataRequest`, `RegisterZatcaDeviceRequest`, `RenewZatcaDeviceRequest`, `CreateZatcaConnectedAccountRequest`, `UpdateZatcaConnectedAccountRequest`, `PartialUpdateZatcaConnectedAccountRequest`.
  - Rules come from [`ZatcaDocumentRules`](src/Support/Zatca/ZatcaDocumentRules.php):
    - B2B documents need a named customer with a street and city.
    - Credit and debit notes need `reference_document_number` and `payment_means` with `code` and `issue_reason`.
    - Non-standard VAT needs an exemption reason; `VATEX-SA-OOS` also needs free text.
    - Prepayment invoices may not carry `prepayments`.
- Code lists: [`ZatcaCodeLists`](src/Support/Zatca/ZatcaCodeLists.php) holds `COUNTRY_CODES`, `CHARGE_REASON_CODES`, `DISCOUNT_REASON_CODES` and `PAYMENT_MEANS_CODES`, generated from the Wafeq ZATCA reference.
- Contracts: [src/Contracts/Zatca](src/Contracts/Zatca/), including `ZatcaClientContract`.
- Enums: [src/Enums/Zatca](src/Enums/Zatca/):
  - Client and API: `ZatcaEnvironment` (`fromApiKey()`), `ZatcaDocumentType` (`path()`, `isSimplified()`, `isNote()`, `isPrepayment()`), `ZatcaDocumentStatus`, `ZatcaDeviceStatus`, `ZatcaWalletBalance`, `ZatcaDownloadType`.
  - Documents: `ZatcaTaxCategory`, `ZatcaExemptionReason` (`category()`, `forCategory()`), `ZatcaCustomerIdentificationType`, `ZatcaSupplierIdentificationType`, `ZatcaDocumentIndicator`, `ZatcaTaxAmountType`, `ZatcaLanguage`.
  - Currencies reuse `Enums\Currency`.
- Concerns: [src/Concerns/Zatca](src/Concerns/Zatca/):
  - `HandlesZatcaResponses` maps the ZATCA error envelope and skips the default-currency lookup.
  - `NormalizesZatcaPayloads` turns DTOs and enums into wire arrays.
- Exceptions: `ZatcaValidationException` (extends `ValidationException`; `zatcaErrors()` lists `{code, detail, attr}`), `ZatcaSubmissionException`, and `ZatcaConfigurationException`.
- Events: under [src/Events/Zatca](src/Events/Zatca/), including `ZatcaDocumentReported`, `ZatcaDocumentIssued`, `ZatcaDeviceRegistered`, and `ZatcaConnectedAccountCreated`.
- Retry policy: ZATCA requests retry only on connection errors and on the `http.retry.when` statuses (429 and 503). Rejected reports are never resubmitted.
- Host: the ZATCA API is only served from `https://api.wafeq.com/v1`, even when the accounting client targets sandbox. The environment header, not the URL, selects simulation.
- Guides: [B2C](https://docs.wafeq.com/zatca/for-b2c), [B2B](https://docs.wafeq.com/zatca/for-b2b), [Platforms and white label](https://docs.wafeq.com/zatca/for-platforms-or-white-label), [ZATCA API index](https://docs.wafeq.com/zatca/llms.txt).

### ZATCA example

```php
use HWafeq\LaravelWafeq\Data\Zatca\Payload\{ZatcaAddressData, ZatcaDocumentPayloadData, ZatcaLineItemData, ZatcaPartyIdentificationData, ZatcaSupplierData};
use HWafeq\LaravelWafeq\Enums\Currency;
use HWafeq\LaravelWafeq\Facades\LaravelWafeq;

$zatca = LaravelWafeq::zatca(); // simulation by default

$zatca->devices()->register('POS 1', $otpFromFatooraPortal);

$document = $zatca->simplifiedInvoices()->report(new ZatcaDocumentPayloadData(
    documentNumber: 'INV-0001',
    currency: Currency::SAR,
    supplyDate: '2026-11-06',
    supplier: new ZatcaSupplierData(
        name: 'ABCD Inc',
        address: new ZatcaAddressData(street: 'Anas Bin Malik', building: '3141', city: 'Riyadh', district: 'Al Malqa', postalCode: '13521'),
        identification: ZatcaPartyIdentificationData::commercialRegistration('1234567890'),
    ),
    lineItems: [ZatcaLineItemData::make('iPhone 15 Pro', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 4699)],
));

$document->isReported(); // true
$document->qrCodeData;   // base64 TLV for the receipt

// Platforms: act on behalf of a connected account.
$zatca->production()->forConnectedAccount('ca_123')->invoices()->report($b2bDocument);

// Controllers: validate, convert, report.
$zatca->simplifiedInvoices()->report($request->toDto()); // ReportZatcaSimplifiedInvoiceRequest
```

## Data transfer objects

- Base: `spatie/laravel-data` classes under [src/Data](src/Data/). Accounting responses use an `extra` catch-all property, so new Wafeq fields do not break existing code. ZATCA DTOs are described in the ZATCA section above.
- Shared DTOs under [src/Data/Shared](src/Data/Shared/):
  - `AccountRefData`
  - `AddressData`
  - `BranchRefData`
  - `CompanyIdentificationData`
  - `ContactRefData`
  - `DimensionRefData`
  - `DualLangData`: `{en, ar}` value object. It implements `Castable`, so a bare string is accepted and wrapped as `{en: $string, ar: null}`.
  - `ItemRefData`
  - `TaxRateRefData`
  - `UserRefData`
  - `WarehouseRefData`

## Enums

- Non-ZATCA enums under [src/Enums](src/Enums/), 19 total: `AccountSubclassification`, `BankAccountSubclassification`, `BillStatus`, `ChargeType`, `Classification`, `Currency`, `DiscountType`, `Environment`, `ExpenseTaxAmountType`, `Language41a`, `LanguageAc1`, `Medium`, `PaymentRequestStatus`, `PayslipStatus`, `SimplifiedInvoiceStatus`, `Status9b4`, `TaxAmountType8ab`, `TaxType`, and `Type`.
- ZATCA enums under [src/Enums/Zatca](src/Enums/Zatca/), 13 total.
- Casting: casts live in [src/Casts](src/Casts/): `DualLangCast`, `LenientEnumCast` (unknown value → `null`; used on ZATCA response enums), and `WithCurrencyCast`. ZATCA payload enums use Spatie's strict `EnumCast` explicitly, so invalid input fails instead of silently becoming `null`.

## FormRequests

- 120 Wafeq FormRequests under [src/Requests](src/Requests/), one per endpoint that takes a request body, plus the base class [`WafeqFormRequest`](src/Requests/WafeqFormRequest.php). Create, update, and partial-update requests are included, along with special actions such as `markAsDraft`, `markAsPosted`, `taxAuthorityReport`, `bulkSend`, `invoice`, `bill`, `previewCreate`, `endEarly`, and `previewEndEarly`.
- Each FormRequest provides `rules()`, `attributes()`, `dto()`, and `toDto()`. Rules are derived from the matching `wafeq-docs/<resource>_<action>.md` spec.
- Partial-update requests make every field `sometimes` and `nullable`. Bodyless endpoints return empty `rules()` and still implement `dto()`.
- ZATCA FormRequests (15, under `Requests\Zatca`) are listed in the ZATCA section above.

## Events

- Each successful resource call dispatches a typed event under [src/Events](src/Events/), grouped by domain. Examples: `Events\Contacts\ContactCreated`, `ContactListed`, `ContactRetrieved`, `ContactUpdated`, `ContactPartiallyUpdated`, and `ContactDestroyed`.
- ZATCA events live under `Events\Zatca`.

## Exceptions

Under [src/Exceptions](src/Exceptions/):

- `WafeqException`: catch-all base for Wafeq errors
- `AuthenticationException`: 401 and 403
- `NotFoundException`: 404
- `ValidationException`: 422, with `context['errors']` holding the field-level map
- `RateLimitException`: 429, with `context['retry_after']`
- `ServerException`: 5xx, after the HTTP client retries
- `ZatcaValidationException`, `ZatcaSubmissionException`, `ZatcaConfigurationException`: ZATCA-specific errors

## Concerns and attributes

- [src/Concerns](src/Concerns/): `HasWafeqResource`, `HoldsWafeqModel`, `HandlesResponses`, `FillsCurrencyDefaults`, and one `InteractsWith<Resource>Model` trait per resource that adds the model-aware overloads.
- [src/Attributes](src/Attributes/): `WithCurrency`, for auto-filling DTO currency properties from the configured default.
- [src/Connector.php](src/Connector.php) and [src/Client.php](src/Client.php): HTTP connector and client, built on Laravel's `Http` client.

## Configuration

- [config/wafeq.php](config/wafeq.php) keys:
  - `environment` (`WAFEQ_ENVIRONMENT`, default `sandbox`)
  - `api_key` (`WAFEQ_API_KEY`, required)
  - `base_urls.sandbox`, `base_urls.production`
  - `http.timeout`, `http.connect_timeout`
  - `http.retry.times`, `http.retry.delay`, `http.retry.when` (429 and 503)
  - `http.log` (`WAFEQ_HTTP_LOG`)
  - `idempotency_header` (`WAFEQ_IDEMPOTENCY_HEADER`)
  - `currency` (`WAFEQ_CURRENCY`)
  - `zatca.environment`, `zatca.api_key`, `zatca.base_url`, `zatca.branch`, `zatca.connected_account`

## Testing

- [`ZatcaFake`](src/Testing/ZatcaFake.php) (`HWafeq\LaravelWafeq\Testing`): ships with the package for applications testing their ZATCA integration offline.
  - `ZatcaFake::fake($overrides)` stubs every ZATCA endpoint. Responses echo the request (document number, reference, metadata), validation computes totals from the line items, and registered devices take the request's branch / connected-account headers. Non-ZATCA requests fall through to other `Http::fake()` stubs.
  - Overrides are keyed by path relative to `/zatca/`, with an optional HTTP method and `*` wildcards (e.g. `'POST invoices/*'`). Values can be an array, an `Http::response()`, or a callable receiving the request.
  - Response builders: `document()`, `device()`, `connectedAccount()`, `usage()`, `page()`, `validationError()`, `submissionError()`, `noActiveDevice()`, `rateLimited()`, `serverError()`.
  - Assertions: `assertReported()`, `assertIssued()`, `assertNotReported()`, `assertNothingReported()`, `assertDeviceRegistered()`, `assertSentToEnvironment()`, `assertSentForConnectedAccount()`, plus `recorded()`.
- [tests/Pests/Concerns/FakesWafeq.php](tests/Pests/Concerns/FakesWafeq.php): the package's internal `FakesWafeq` trait for the accounting API (autoload-dev only, not shipped to applications). Helpers: `fakeWafeq($path, $body)`, `fakeWafeqPage()`, `fakeNotFound()`, `fakeValidationError()`, `fakeRateLimit()`, `fakeServerError()`, and `fakeAuthError()`.
- Test runner: Pest. Run with `./vendor/bin/pest`.

- [Client contract](src/Contracts/ClientContract.php): accessor for every resource and for `zatca()`
